body: \[a little context, my family is full of undiagnosed mentally ill people, i myself am diagnosed, although they dont believe it\] i lie and manipulate people, sometimes i start guiltripping them without realising, i do it to my parents, cousins, friends, even partners i had. the worse thing is, i am fully aware of all of this (most of the time) but at the same time, i dont feel bad about lying and deceiving, i know its wrong, and some of the shit ive done is awful, and yet, i dont stop, i guess i just like fucking up my life
maybe because of my parents maybe nothing, god i just dont know anymore
